title: Adding with regrouping: 27 + 15
examples: What does carrying mean in addition?

explain.say: Kofi has 27 marbles and wins 15 more. How many now? Look at the blocks: 27 on top, 15 below. Let us put them together and watch something clever happen. The answer will be 42.
Always start with the ones. 7 ones and 5 ones make 12 ones. See the small cubes pile up? That is more than 9, too many for the ones place! What could we do with ten of them?
We swap 10 ones for 1 ten rod. That is regrouping, which means making a new group of ten. So 12 ones becomes 1 ten and 2 ones. See the new rod? Where do you think it goes?
Now the tens. 2 tens and 1 ten, plus the new ten we made, give 4 tens. That is 40. Add the 2 ones and you get 42. So 27 plus 15 equals 42. Can you count the 4 rods and 2 cubes?
Brilliant work! When you write it in columns, you put a little 1 above the tens to remember the new ten. People call it carrying. Try 38 plus 46 yourself, then check the board: it shows 84!

faq.a: Regrouping means swapping 10 ones for 1 ten, or 1 ten for 10 ones. The amount stays the same; it is just packed differently.

faq.q: What does carrying mean in addition?
faq.a: When the ones add up to 10 or more, you carry the new ten into the tens column. You write a small 1 above the tens to remember it.

faq.q: Why do we start adding from the ones?
faq.a: Because the ones might make a new ten that has to move into the tens column. If you start with the tens, you may have to go back and fix them.
asks: Why not add the tens first?

faq.a: Add the ones: 7 plus 5 is 12, so write 2 and carry 1 ten. Add the tens: 2 plus 1 plus the carried 1 is 4. The answer is 42.

faq.q: When do I need to regroup?
faq.a: Only when a column adds up to 10 or more. 23 plus 14 needs no regrouping, because 3 plus 4 is only 7.
asks: Do I always need to carry?

facts: Regrouping works because 10 ones are worth exactly 1 ten.

quiz.why: 6 plus 8 is 14, more than 9, so you must regroup.

wrong.1: 1 plus 5 is only 6, so no regrouping is needed.
wrong.2: 2 plus 4 is only 6, so no regrouping is needed.

quiz.why: 6 plus 7 is 13: write 3 and carry 1. Then 4 plus 3 plus 1 is 8. So 83.

wrong.0: 73 forgets to add the carried ten.
wrong.2: 713 writes 13 in the ones place instead of regrouping.
